design_name: Outcome-unseen neighboring-electrocatalysis borrowing on Caltech acid OER
status: archive hash verified; target header known; one accidental target row and one raw record permanently excluded; remaining target outcomes unopened
claim_guard: This is the prespecified second scientific-family opportunity. Every remaining plate and every source/control stays in the denominator; failure or abstention cannot be replaced by another analysis of the same outcomes.

target.entity: original row identity plus plate and normalized Mn/Sb/Sn/Ti/Co composition
representations: element fractions plus frozen XRD phase/context features when an exact plate/composition join exists
permanent_exclusions: plate 5411 row with Mn=0.58, Sb=0.09, Sn=0.26, Ti=0.07, Co=0
target.groups: plate is the outer independent unit; outcome-free composition clusters are the inner exploration unit
target.outer_evaluation: four leave-one-remaining-plate-out folds over plates 5411, 5412, 5413, and 5414

expected_positive.rationale: independent high-throughput metal-oxide oxygen-electrocatalysis current after two hours

prediction.primary_endpoint: paired relative RMSE reduction on the held-out plate and its highest outcome-free OOD quartile
prediction.absolute_gate: positive augmented-model R2 on held-out plate

co_primary: acquisitions to first distinct top-5-percent cluster

hypothesis_cards.timing: after outcome-free target metadata and source ranks, before any remaining target outcome is parsed
hypothesis_cards.minimum: one ORR-specific card, one OCx-specific card, and one consensus card

inference.unit: held-out plate and outcome-free composition cluster
inference.within_target: paired plate/cluster bootstrap and source-rank randomization
inference.multiplicity: Holm within target and endpoint family
inference.across_targets: combine only after Starrydata and acid-OER target-level effects are fixed; report random-effects mean and heterogeneity
